import.title: Import from a spreadsheet
import.intro: Set up many units or residents at once. Download the template, fill it in with Excel or Google Sheets, save it as CSV, then choose the file. The file is checked first, and nothing is saved unless every row is correct.
import.unitsColumns: unit_number, floor, size_sqft (optional), bedrooms (optional), opening_balance (optional, in taka)
import.residentsColumns: full_name, login_id (email or mobile), phone, unit_number, type (owner or tenant), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), billing_contact (yes or no). Leave unit_number, type and start_date empty for a resident who is not in a unit yet.
import.ready: The file is ready: {{count}} rows, no problems found.
import.problems: {{count}} problems found. Nothing was saved. Fix the file and choose it again.
import.credentialsHelp: These temporary passwords are shown only once. Print or copy them now and hand each one to the right person. Everyone must choose a new password when they first log in.
